rationale: Erta brings product management expertise from medical-robotics and SaaS (Veeva, Tendo) with strong quantitative and user-centered design skills, while Kevin is building AI-driven quality assurance software at Zof with conviction that AI should amplify rather than replace human capabilities. Kevin's technical leadership background and focus on organizational alignment for AI adoption could benefit from Erta's product rigor and cross-domain experience, while Erta may find valuable perspective on AI-native product strategy from someone shipping in the QA-testing space.
intro_message: Erta Muca, meet Kevin Kissi — you're both in San Francisco working on AI + software, and Kevin's insights on technical excellence and human-centered AI adoption could spark useful thinking for your next product phase.
